summary.headline: Vascon Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue fell to INR152 crores (from INR221 crores) and PAT to INR2 crores (from INR22 crores), on EPC execution delays.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations fell about 31% YoY to INR152 crores, driven by lower EPC execution from cash-flow-stalled government projects. Consolidated EBITDA was INR10 crores versus INR34 crores in Q1 FY26, which included an INR18 crores one-time investment gain; adjusted for that, EBITDA was about INR15 crores at roughly 6% margin. Management said the EPC segment stayed profitable at about 9% EBITDA margin, while real estate booked INR4 crores revenue and a INR4 crores EBITDA loss. Management guided to a recovery from Q3 and reiterated the FY27 revenue target of INR1,200 crores, while net debt rose to about INR152 crores.

segments.name: EPC
segments.commentary: Revenue ~INR148 crores (vs INR203 crores), EBITDA ~INR13 crores at ~9% margin. Total EPC order book ~INR2,850 crores (external INR2,531 crores, internal INR319 crores), about 3x FY26 EPC revenue.

segments.name: Real Estate
segments.commentary: Revenue ~INR4 crores with EBITDA loss ~INR4 crores, attributed to timing of revenue recognition and associated costs. Q1 booking value INR66 crores vs INR113 crores for all of FY26; Orchid booked ~INR38 crores in Q1, cumulative ~INR87 crores.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated revenue target still INR1,200 crores, including INR200 crores-plus from real estate; management said EPC should reach at least last year's ~INR900 crores and hopes for ~INR1,000 crores.
EPC phasing revised: Q1+Q2 expected at ~30% of FY revenue and Q3+Q4 at ~70% (vs typical 40:60).
FY27 EPC new order intake target INR1,500-2,000 crores.
Real estate: target annual booking value INR1,200-1,500 crores by FY31; management expects to double real estate revenue over 3-4 years from a ~INR100 crores base.
Real estate OC targets this year for Coimbatore, Tower of Ascend (Kharadi) in Q3/Q4 and Orchid Santacruz in Q4 (stretch), which would drive revenue recognition.
Working capital cycle expected to normalise from ~65-70 days back toward ~45 days; EPC short-term debt expected to roll over in 6-8 months.
capex_capacity: Sanctioned banking limits ~INR760 crores as of June 30, 2026, of which ~INR355 crores unutilised.
INR80 crores preferential warrant issue over up to 18 months; first tranche (minimum 25%) received; proceeds ~60-70% for real estate, rest for EPC working capital and corporate purposes.

Real estate pipeline: Tranquil Heights (Powai) launched in second week of June; Prakash (Santacruz West) has RERA approval, launch shortly; Tower of Future (Baner, Pune) and Ajanta (Kharadi) in near-term pipeline; together ~1.74 million sq ft, ~INR2,000 crores sales value (~INR1,000 crores attributable to Vascon).
Thane land parcel (150 acres, Vascon holds 45%) still under acquisition process; no timeline for continuous parcel, at least a year plus.
demand_pricing: Q1 new EPC award: CPWD order of INR295 crores for RBI Colony in Guwahati; LOI of INR126 crores (ex-GST) from Maharashtra PWD for a 300-bed General Hospital at Wardha received August 12, 2026.
Management stated gross profit on EPC remains 13-15%, and real estate gross margin is 25-30%.
Real estate sales: 30,690 sq ft new bookings and ~INR20 crores collections in Q1.
Competition in Mumbai redevelopment described as intense; management targets projects with GDV of INR250-300 crores and focuses on 1-2 acre sites in Western and Central suburbs.
Adani Infra engagement on 3-4 projects at an early design stage; management does not expect construction start in the next 6 months, and revenue may slip to Q4 or next year.

Royal Rides (Goa, ~INR225 crores ropeway-related order): only ~INR15 crores recognised; management assumes no revenue for the next 3 quarters. Reliance order was cancelled by mutual agreement after design and construction method changes.

qa_highlights.question: How much real estate construction spend is pending, and what free cash flow can come from sold and unsold projects?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said real estate gross margins remain 25-30%, with ~INR300 crores of pending construction cost against ~INR400 crores unsold inventory value plus ~INR116 crores pending collections, implying ~INR220 crores free cash flow.

qa_highlights.question: Why has debt risen sharply since March 2025 and where did the cash go?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed the rise mainly to EPC: CC limit utilisation increased on milestone-based projects, and net working capital cycle stretched from ~45 to ~65-70 days over the last six months. Real estate also needed equity infusion.

qa_highlights.question: Which government projects face cash-flow issues and when will they ramp up?
qa_highlights.answer: Bihar Supaul and Sindhudurg (Maharashtra) projects; client cash flows now available and ramp-up expected within 1-2 months.

qa_highlights.question: Which real estate projects will recognise revenue and when?
qa_highlights.answer: Coimbatore and Tower of Ascend (Kharadi) OC targeted in Q3/Q4; Orchid Santacruz targeted for Q4 only if achieved.

qa_highlights.question: Status of Vedanta project, Royal Rides and Vashi Hospital?
qa_highlights.answer: Vedanta has restarted with scale-up and is expected to finish this FY; Vashi Hospital expected to start in the coming quarter; Royal Rides stalled with no client go-ahead, assumed zero revenue for next 3 quarters, but still a live order.

qa_highlights.question: Is the FY27 INR1,200 crore revenue target still valid?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated INR1,200 crores, with EPC at ~INR1,000 crores and real estate INR200 crores-plus, with Q3/Q4 carrying ~70% of EPC revenue.

risks_watch: Ramp-up of EPC execution: Bihar Supaul and Sindhudurg projects were said to restart within 1-2 months of client cash flows; watch Q2 EPC revenue against the 30% H1 phasing assumption.

Real estate revenue depends on OC timing: Coimbatore and Tower of Ascend (Kharadi) in Q3/Q4 and Orchid Santacruz in Q4 only if achieved; any slip pushes the INR200 crores-plus real estate contribution further out.

Net debt rise to ~INR152 crores and working capital cycle stretched from ~45 to ~65-70 days; watch whether the cycle normalises toward 45 days and whether short-term EPC debt rolls over in 6-8 months.

Royal Rides (~INR225 crores order, ~INR15 crores recognised) assumed at zero revenue for three quarters; Vashi Hospital expected to start next quarter; Adani Infra projects unlikely to start construction within 6 months.

Real estate growth target of INR1,200-1,500 crores annual booking value by FY31 requires new project acquisitions; no new transaction assigned yet, and management expects to convert opportunities over 2-3 quarters.
key_quotes: We consider this primarily a timing -related execution issue rather than a structural concern with our order book.
So this financial year, we still target to achieve INR1,200 crores because we do expect INR200 crores plus revenue coming from real estate as well, which did not come in last year.
It has been one of the worst quarters we've had over the last 3 to 4 years, but I think there's nothing structurally wrong that has led to that.
I wish I knew the answer to that question.
summary.management_tone: Management was candid that Q1 FY27 was one of the weakest quarters in 3-4 years, attributing it to temporary client cash-flow constraints and execution timing rather than structural issues. It was confident on the FY27 INR1,200 crores revenue target and the EPC order intake target, but cautious and vague on Adani Infra timing, Royal Rides, and Vedanta, and it declined to forecast the Adani numbers.
